$comment: What the tree expects of production's realtime tier (docs/REALTIME.md 3.7 and 5.4 item 3; scripts/hosting/README.md). The production guard (~/.config/turboslide/gt-follow.sh with the realtime round's patch) reads `realtime` from the checked out sha before its production deploy: `redis` holds the sha while REDIS_URL is absent from the production environment names, `blob` or no file checks nothing. `node scripts/hosting/realtime-env.mjs flip` writes redis when it removes the forced TURBOSLIDE_REALTIME row and `rollback` writes blob; each is committed with the push that changes the environment. Hand edits follow the same rule: the value names the tier production selects after the environment change, never a wish.
